title: Ball flight time
description: Essential: The student must correctly compute the time of flight t = 3 s using the final vertical velocity and kinematic equations.

title: Launch height H
description: Essential: The student must correctly compute the launch height H = 15 m from the vertical displacement and its magnitude.

title: Cart motion setup
description: Important: The student must relate the cart's horizontal uniformly accelerated motion (starting from rest) to the ball's flight time.

title: Acceleration lower bound
description: Important: The student must derive the minimum acceleration (8/9 m/s²) so the cart's front reaches the impact point in time.

title: Acceleration upper bound
description: Important: The student must derive the maximum acceleration (2 m/s²) so the cart's rear does not pass the impact point before the ball lands.

title: Sign error in displacement
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student treats the vertical displacement h = -15 m as positive or misinterprets the sign when finding H.

title: Velocity direction mistake
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student uses an incorrect sign for the final vertical velocity (should be -20 m/s) in the time calculation.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Award if the student explicitly verifies that all quantities are in consistent SI units (m, s, m/s²).
